name: Setup: every seat holds 2 hidden cards and the deck holds 15 - 2x3 = 9 (checked after one Income, which moves no card)
rule_text: When the game is set up, the deck has 15 cards (3 each of Duke, Assassin, Captain, Ambassador, Contessa), each player has hidden_count = 2, and deck_count = 15 - 2 x player count.

name: Setup with 5 players: deck holds 5 (checked after one Income)
rule_text: When the game is set up, the deck has 15 cards (3 each of Duke, Assassin, Captain, Ambassador, Contessa), each player has hidden_count = 2, and deck_count = 15 - 2 x player count.

name: Setup: seat 1 starts with 1 coin (2 after one Income), the other seats with 2
rule_text: When the game is set up, seat 1 has coins = 1 and every other seat has coins = 2.

name: Income gives exactly 1 coin and nobody can challenge or block it
rule_text: When a player takes Income unchallenged and unblocked, then their coins rise by exactly 1, and no player is offered a challenge or block.

name: Foreign Aid nobody blocks gives 2 coins
rule_text: When a player takes Foreign Aid and nobody blocks, then their coins rise by 2.

name: Foreign Aid blocked as Duke, nobody challenges: no coins
rule_text: When a player takes Foreign Aid and another player blocks as Duke and nobody challenges the block, then the active player's coins do not change.

name: Foreign Aid cannot be challenged
rule_text: When a player takes Foreign Aid, then challenge is not offered against the action.

name: Coup costs 7, target loses one card, no challenge or block
rule_text: When a player with 7 or more coins takes Coup on a target, then their coins fall by 7 and the target loses 1 hidden card; nobody may challenge or block.

name: With 6 coins Coup is not offered
rule_text: When a player has fewer than 7 coins, then Coup is not among their options.

name: At 10 coins Coup is the only option
rule_text: When a player starts their turn with 10 or more coins, then Coup is their only option.

name: Tax nobody challenges gives 3 coins
rule_text: When a player takes Tax and nobody challenges, then their coins rise by 3.

name: Assassinate pays 3 even when it fails a challenge
rule_text: When a player with 3 or more coins takes Assassinate, then their coins fall by 3 at once, even if the action is later blocked or fails a challenge.

name: Assassinate pays 3 even when blocked
rule_text: When a player with 3 or more coins takes Assassinate, then their coins fall by 3 at once, even if the action is later blocked or fails a challenge.

name: With 2 coins Assassinate is not offered
rule_text: When a player has fewer than 3 coins, then Assassinate is not among their options.

name: Unblocked Assassinate: target loses one card
rule_text: When Assassinate goes ahead unblocked, then the target loses 1 hidden card.

name: Contessa block unchallenged: target keeps cards, no refund
rule_text: When the target of Assassinate blocks as Contessa and nobody challenges the block, then the target loses no card and the assassin's 3 coins are not refunded.

name: Steal from a target with 4 coins moves 2
rule_text: When a player Steals from a target with 2 or more coins and the action goes ahead, then the target's coins fall by 2 and the active player's coins rise by 2.

name: Steal from a target with 1 coin moves 1
rule_text: When a player Steals from a target with 1 coin and the action goes ahead, then the target ends with 0 coins and the active player gains 1; with 0 coins, nobody's coins change.

name: Steal from a target with 0 coins moves nothing
rule_text: When a player Steals from a target with 1 coin and the action goes ahead, then the target ends with 0 coins and the active player gains 1; with 0 coins, nobody's coins change.

name: Steal blocked as Captain, unchallenged: no coins move
rule_text: When the target of a Steal blocks as Captain or as Ambassador and nobody challenges the block, then no coins move.

name: Steal blocked as Ambassador, unchallenged: no coins move
rule_text: When the target of a Steal blocks as Captain or as Ambassador and nobody challenges the block, then no coins move.

name: Only the Steal target is offered the Captain/Ambassador blocks
rule_text: When a player other than the target answers a Steal or Assassinate, then they are not offered block_contessa, block_captain or block_ambassador.

name: Only the Assassinate target is offered the Contessa block
rule_text: When a player other than the target answers a Steal or Assassinate, then they are not offered block_contessa, block_captain or block_ambassador.

name: Exchange keeps hidden_count and deck size
rule_text: When a player takes Exchange and the action goes ahead, then they draw 1 card from the deck and return 1 hidden card of their choice, ending with the same hidden_count and the same deck_count.

name: Exchange return is not revealed
rule_text: When an Exchange returns a card, then the returned card is never announced.

name: Challenged true Tax: challenger loses a card, Tax still pays
rule_text: When a challenged active player holds the claimed role, then that card goes into the deck, they draw a replacement (keeping hidden_count), the first challenger in seat order after them loses 1 hidden card, and the action continues.

name: Challenged bluff Tax: bluffer loses a card, no coins
rule_text: When a challenged active player does not hold the claimed role, then they lose 1 hidden card, the action has no effect, and any block is ignored.

name: Challenged bluff Steal: no coins move and the block is ignored
rule_text: When a challenged active player does not hold the claimed role, then they lose 1 hidden card, the action has no effect, and any block is ignored.

name: Two challengers of a true Tax: only the first after the active seat loses
rule_text: When several players challenge the action, then only the first challenger in seat order after the active player can lose a card from it.

name: Two Duke blockers: only the first counts (its true Duke beats the block challenge)
rule_text: When several players block, then only the first blocker in seat order after the active player counts.

name: Challenged true Captain block: block challenger loses, Steal blocked
rule_text: When a challenged blocker holds the blocking role, then that card goes into the deck, they draw a replacement, the first block challenger in seat order after the blocker loses 1 hidden card, and the action is blocked.

name: Challenged false Duke block: blocker loses, Foreign Aid pays
rule_text: When a challenged blocker does not hold the blocking role, then the blocker loses 1 hidden card and the action goes ahead.

name: False Contessa block challenged: target takes 2 losses and is eliminated
rule_text: When the Assassinate target's Contessa block is challenged and they do not hold Contessa, then the target gets 2 pending losses and, holding 2 hidden cards, is eliminated.

name: One loss from two cards: the player reveals the card they choose
rule_text: When a player with 2 hidden cards gets exactly 1 pending loss, then they reveal the one card they choose and keep the other hidden.

name: Loss on the last card: all revealed, out, coins 0
rule_text: When a player's pending losses are equal to or more than their hidden cards, then all their hidden cards are revealed, alive becomes false, and their coins become 0.

name: A revealed card stays revealed on the next turn
rule_text: When a card is revealed, then it moves to revealed_cards, stays public, and never returns to the hand.

name: A loss does not carry into the next turn
rule_text: When a turn ends, then every pending_loss is 0.

name: Next turn skips an eliminated seat
rule_text: When a turn ends and the game goes on, then the next turn belongs to the next seat with alive = true, skipping eliminated seats.

name: Coup target must be a living other seat; the chosen seat takes the hit
rule_text: When a target is chosen, then it must be another player with alive = true.

name: Last opponent loses their last card: seat 1 wins
rule_text: When only one player has hidden_count >= 1, then the game ends and that seat wins.

name: Turn 40 ends the game: most hidden cards wins
rule_text: When 40 turns have been played and more than one player is alive, then the seat with the most hidden cards wins; a tie goes to the most coins; a remaining tie is a draw.

name: Reactions are polled: both challengers are offered challenge, first one loses
rule_text: When players react to an action or a block, then they answer in a poll, and no one sees another's answer until all are in.

name: Steal target choice offers only other living seats
rule_text: When a player chooses a target for coup, assassinate or steal, then the only seats offered are those with alive = true and seat != active_seat, and the active seat is never offered as a target.

name: Exchange reactions: only pass and challenge, no blocks
rule_text: When reactions to the action are polled and action is tax or exchange, then every living player except the active player is offered only pass and challenge (challenge only if claimed_role is set) and no block_duke, block_contessa, block_captain or block_ambassador is offered to any seat.

name: Tax reactions: no blocks offered
rule_text: When reactions to the action are polled and action is tax or exchange, then every living player except the active player is offered only pass and challenge (challenge only if claimed_role is set) and no block_duke, block_contessa, block_captain or block_ambassador is offered to any seat.

name: Foreign Aid reactions: pass and block_duke only
rule_text: When reactions to the action are polled and action is foreign_aid, then every living player except the active player is offered only pass and block_duke, challenge is not offered and block_contessa, block_captain and block_ambassador are not offered.

name: Assassinate reactions: target may block as Contessa, others only pass/challenge
rule_text: When reactions to the action are polled and action is assassinate, then the target is offered pass, challenge and block_contessa and every other living player except the active player and the target is offered only pass and challenge and is not offered any block.

name: Steal reactions: target may block as Captain/Ambassador, others only pass/challenge
rule_text: When reactions to the action are polled and action is steal, then the target is offered pass, challenge, block_captain and block_ambassador and every other living player except the active player and the target is offered only pass and challenge and is not offered any block.

name: Exchange with 4 players: deck stays at 15 - 8 = 7 and hand stays at 2
rule_text: When Exchange goes ahead and the active player draws 1 card from deck and returns 1 card to deck, then deck_count before the draw and after the return are equal and hidden_count is unchanged.

name: Eliminated seat: alive false, no cards, no coins, and skipped and never polled next turn
rule_text: When a player's pending losses are equal to or more than their hidden cards (R29), then in that same turn's Resolve step alive = false, hidden_count = 0, coins = 0 and living_count falls by exactly 1; that seat is eliminated for the rest of the game, is never polled or asked again, and is reported as eliminated, not active, at the end of the game.

name: 4 players, seats 3 and 4 already out: seat 2 coups seat 1's last card and wins
rule_text: When the game ends because living_count = 1, then winner = the seat number of the only player with alive = true. That seat is the single winner and every seat with alive = false has lost. Example: with 4 players, if seats 1, 3 and 4 are eliminated, then winner = 2 and seats 1, 3 and 4 have lost.

name: Turn 40, two seats tie on hidden cards: the one with more coins wins
rule_text: When the game ends because turn_count >= 40 and living_count > 1, then winner = the seat with alive = true and the highest hidden_count. A tie goes to the tied seat with the most coins. If seats are still tied, winner = draw and no seat wins. Every seat that is not the winner has lost.

name: Turn 40, tied on hidden cards and coins: draw
rule_text: When the game ends because turn_count >= 40 and living_count > 1, then winner = the seat with alive = true and the highest hidden_count. A tie goes to the tied seat with the most coins. If seats are still tied, winner = draw and no seat wins. Every seat that is not the winner has lost.

name: Challenged true Steal: claimant keeps 2 hidden cards and the deck keeps 9 (the drawn card is chance, not asserted)
rule_text: When a challenged active player holds the claimed role, then the order is fixed: first they draw 1 replacement card at random from deck into hidden_cards, and only after that is the claimed_role card moved from their hidden_cards to deck. hidden_count is unchanged, deck_count is the same before and after, and the replacement draw can never be the card that was just shown.

name: Challenged true Contessa block: blocker keeps 2 hidden cards, deck keeps 9, block challenger loses (drawn card is chance)
rule_text: When a challenged blocker holds block_role, then the order is fixed: first they draw 1 replacement card at random from deck into hidden_cards, and only after that is the block_role card moved from their hidden_cards to deck. hidden_count is unchanged, deck_count is the same before and after, and the replacement draw can never be the card that was just shown.

name: Three seats challenge a true Duke block: only the first after the blocker loses
rule_text: When several players answer challenge to a block, then block_challenger = the first seat in seat order after blocker whose block_response = challenge. Only that seat can take a pending loss from the block challenge. Every other block challenger's pending_loss is unchanged by it.

name: Challenged true Exchange: proven card goes back, Exchange still runs, counts unchanged (which cards are drawn is chance)
rule_text: When a card is put into the deck during a turn (the revealed card of a proven claim or block, or the card an Exchange returns), then it is placed at the BOTTOM of the deck, the next draw in that turn takes the TOP card, and the deck is shuffled once at the end of the turn; so a card cannot be drawn back in the turn it was put in unless the deck has no other card.

name: Target challenges a true Assassinate: loses one card to the challenge and one to the action, so is eliminated
rule_text: The rules text players read says that when a challenge to an action fails, the challenger loses a card AND the action still goes ahead (so a target who challenges a true Assassinate still loses a card to it), and it describes a proven claim in the order draw the replacement, put the shown card into the deck, shuffle at the end of the turn.
